drhp.business: Mahickra Chemicals Limited manufactures pigments, dyes, intermediates, and specialty chemicals, headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Its products serve textile, coatings, plastics and printing-ink end-users across India and international markets spanning Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas. The Company is shifting its product mix away from lower-margin commodity offerings toward higher-margin, value-added and sustainable product lines, anchored by its R&D function.
drhp.expansion: The Company is expanding its dealer network across India and internationally, targeting regions with economic and political stability to build durable long-term partnerships. It has strengthened its export sales organisation with the appointment of an International Marketing Manager to drive growth in untapped international markets. No named capex project, site, or commissioning timeline is disclosed in this bundle.
